title: Automated Cloud CI/CD Pipeline & Production Deployment Workflow

nodes.label:
1. Git Push / Pull Request
Developer triggers webhook on main branch

2. Static Analysis & Linting
Run ESLint, Flake8, SonarQube & secret scanners

3. Automated Test Suite
Execute unit, integration & mocked API contracts

4. Container Image Build
Multi-stage Dockerfile, vulnerability scan (Trivy)

5. Publish to Container Registry
Tag SHA & push to Google Artifact Registry / ECR

6. Staging Environment Deployment
Helm upgrade & automated smoke testing

7. Canary Production Rollout
Direct 10% traffic, monitor error rates & latency

8. Full Promotion & Monitoring
100% rollout, Datadog alerts & Prometheus metrics
